OakVerification.checkRUP_sound.claim: Successful decoded RUP checks yield a Propagate derivation.

differential.exhaustive_domain: One variable, all two-entry clause databases and target clauses, hints of length 0..3 over [-1,0,1,2,3].
differential.other_cases: Seeded three-variable cases, explicit multi-unit chains, and decoded addition/deletion stream regressions.
differential.oracle: Every accepted Go RUP or full-proof decision also passes an independent exhaustive truth table.

limits: The theorem verifies the Lean checker on decoded instructions, not the Go implementation.
Differential agreement is finite testing, not a Go-to-Lean refinement theorem.
JSON and DIMACS/LRAT parsing, resource limits, and source-to-CNF translation remain outside the proof.
RAT and theory lemmas remain unsupported.
